scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix api
scripts.start: npm run docker && sleep 5 && npm run dev
scripts.ci-all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix api
scripts.lint-all: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix api
scripts.build-all: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix api
scripts.test-all: npm run test:ci --prefix client && npm run test --prefix api
